# Rudis — Maturity & Limits Statement

## Current phase

Rudis is in an active PRE-D3 campaign.

```text
PRE-D3 = ACTIVE
D3 OPEN = NO
D4 / PRODUCTION = NO
REAL CUSTOMERS = NO
REAL MONEY = NO
```

This statement is intended for external evaluators and must be read together with the public PRE-D3 campaign and current public audit record.

## What exists

Rudis currently has:

- a public constitutional and architectural Corpus;
- public decision and audit records;
- a private implementation under active development;
- a controlled PRE-D3 program focused on integration, reproducibility, restart/recovery, security, causal traceability and independent falsification;
- public security/disclosure rules designed to preserve auditability without exposing unnecessary attack surface.

## What may be true at component level

Individual components or properties may be:

- implemented;
- tested;
- reviewed;
- reproducible by a second actor;
- independently attacked;
- conditionally passed;
- held or failed pending repair.

These states do not automatically compose into whole-system readiness.

`COMPONENT PASS != SYSTEM PASS`

`BUILDER CLAIM != INDEPENDENT EVIDENCE`

`CI GREEN != ACCREDITATION`

## What is not claimed

Rudis does not currently claim, as a whole, to be:

- production ready;
- open for D3;
- enterprise ready;
- fully secure;
- formally verified end-to-end;
- independently accredited end-to-end;
- deployed for real customers;
- handling real money;
- authorized for irreversible external integrations.

Any stronger claim must identify its exact component, scope, evidence and accreditation status.

## Meaning of PRE-D3

PRE-D3 is a controlled preparation phase, not production and not a commercial deployment stage.

Its purpose is to turn a D2 system into a candidate that can be:

```text
INTEGRATED
-> BROKEN
-> REPAIRED
-> REPRODUCED
-> RECOVERED
-> REATTACKED
-> ACCREDITED
-> PRESENTED FOR D3 AUTHORIZATION
```

A successful technical candidate still requires separate competent authorization before D3 opens.

`D3 READY != D3 OPEN`

## External communication rule

External communications must distinguish:

```text
CANON / ARCHITECTURE
IMPLEMENTATION
TEST EVIDENCE
INDEPENDENT VERIFICATION
ACCREDITATION
D3 AUTHORIZATION
PRODUCTION
```

No single layer implies the next.

## Safe shorthand

A safe external description is:

> Rudis is a constitutional and systems-architecture project with a public Corpus and a private implementation currently undergoing PRE-D3 integration, security hardening, recovery testing, reproducibility work and independent falsification. Technical progress is deliberately separated from authorization to enter D3 or production.
